scenes.name: THREE TURNING PLANES
lines: Imagine three turns, then undo each one. Reversing the order cancels everything. What if we undo turn two, then one, then three?
想象三个转动，然后分别反做。逆序反做会完全抵消。如果按二、一、三的次序反做呢？
In Jenzer's triangle, the three plane symbols multiply to minus one. So the forward chain has an extra real term: the star condition fails.
在 Jenzer 的三角形中，三个平面记号相乘等于负一。单程积因此多出一个实数项：星条件不成立。

scenes.name: COUNT THE UNCHANGED PAIRS
lines: The loop formula still works. Pick a subset using biased coins. Change the sign for each chosen pair whose order stays the same.
往返公式依然成立。用偏心硬币选一个子集；选中的一对若前后顺序不变，就翻转一次符号。
Here those pairs are one and three, and two and three. With fair coins, the four subsets without three are all positive.
这里这样的对是 一与三、二与三。用公平硬币时，不含三的四个子集符号全为正。
The four with three cancel two against two. The average sign is one half. Reverse the return and there are no pairs to count.
含三的四个子集两正两负，彼此抵消。平均符号为二分之一。改用逆序回程，就没有这样的编号对了。

scenes.name: WHY THE EXTRA TERMS VANISH
lines: Most mismatched subsets give zero by a sign flip that preserves the scalar part. The only possible exception uses every index once, in odd size.
大多数不相同的子集配对可用变号消去，因为相应变换保持标量部分。唯一可能的例外是奇数个下标各出现一次。
Track just those signs with symbols whose squares are zero. Swapping two return factors adds a correction of degree two. Reversing the return then lets the originals cancel.
用平方为零的记号追踪这些符号。每次交换两个回程因子，只附加一个二次修正。把回程排成逆序后，原因子两两抵消。
The corrections have only even degrees, so the odd coefficient is zero. The exceptional terms vanish together, not one by one.
修正因子只有偶数次，因此奇次系数为零。那些例外项是一起抵消的，并不是每项都为零。

scenes.name: THE LOOP IS NOT THE CHAIN
lines: The forward chain can remember the triangle. The loop's scalar part still obeys the same subset rule, for every return order.
单程积仍可记住三角形。但无论按什么顺序返回，往返积的标量部分都遵守同一条子集规则。
